messages:
maria: quick morning async — updates and blockers

maria: pushed prototype for the adaptive rate-policy to staging last night. config lives in `infra/gateway/rate-policies/adaptive.yaml`.

maria: blocker: staging e2e is flaky — some requests get 429 unexpectedly when we expect burst allowance. can someone look at the token-bucket implementation?

sam: I can take the flakiness. saw similar noise in canary a few days ago, might be the burst window math. tagging @jia for the test infra side. :mag:

jia: on it. I'll run the repro suite against the staging cluster now and share logs. can you paste the failing request pattern?

maria: example request we saw: `POST /v1/generate` with header `x-rw-client: mobile-sdk` and ~120 concurrent tokens. curl for repro:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":256}'
```

dan: small note on PRs — I left one comment in PR #432 about extracting the backoff into a helper. otherwise looks good. will do a followup if tests pass. :thumbsup:

sam: taking PR #432 review now. will approve if CI green.

oliver: question on routing: when adaptive rate-policy triggers, do we route to cheaper model variant or queue requests? need clarity for canary.

maria: current plan: routing policy prefers cheaper model variant first (same latency SLO), fallback to queueing only if no compatible variant available. should add this to the policy YAML as comments.

oliver: thanks — can you add a one-liner to the docs so ops know expected behavior during surge?

maria: will add to docs as part of PR.

jia: reproduced the 429 locally, root cause looks like our burst window resets slightly earlier than token refill. pushing a test patch that increases the refill granularity.

maria: awesome. once jia's test patch lands, I'll re-run the staging e2e.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: staging/gateway/adaptive-rate-policy @ service/gateway 1839007900

sam: landed review and merged #432. minor lint fixes.

maria: thx. next on my list: schedule token rotation for service accounts Friday 09:00 PST — heads up to anyone using staging keys.

dan: note — if you rotate keys, update `secrets-sink` and the deploy pipeline. I'll prepare a checklist.

oliver: ping me when checklist's ready, I need to update the routing smoke tests to use the rotated token.

maria: checklist draft: 1) rotate keys in KMS 2) update secrets-sink 3) roll secrets deployment 4) run smoke tests 5) monitor latency/cost dashboard. sharing in #eng-ops later.

jia: tests patched and running. will update thread with results in ~20m.

maria: perfect. otherwise no other blockers from my side. thanks all. :raised_hands:

sam: quick FYI — I'll be OOO Thursday afternoon, will hand-off any lingering review to @dan.

dan: got it.

jia: repro fixed, no more 429s in my run. leaving comment with logs and test artifact link.

maria: great news. i'll re-run staging CI later and then promote. closing this async check-in.
